summary: Decomposed xTD (zone x type: team plays x coach pass-rate x player share x conversion) vs old pooled TD model. Week-1 (prior-season-only) = dead heat; in-season rolling = xTD wins clearly in both seasons.

week1_fair_calibrated_2024to2025.note: recalibrate on 2023->24, evaluate 2024->25. Equal: both models draw from the same stale prior (GL role only 29% sticky YoY).

in_season_rolling.note: this season's weeks 1..k-1 predict week k, weeks 4-18. xTD ~2-3% better Brier, replicated. The edge is RESPONSIVENESS to current-season role/tendency changes.

calibration_fit.note: raw Poisson xTD is over-dispersed (low bucket under-predicts 8% vs 16% realized, top bucket over-predicts); linear recal compresses.

decision: ADOPT xTD as the TD model with calibration. Week 1: blend w_xtd=0.55 with old (equal, hedge). Ramp w_xtd toward ~0.85 by week 5 as current-season shares accrue (where it dominates).
